Pree, I found three ticket numbers for Marrow Fieldworks and one more that might belong to it. I've sent you the list in our DM.

1. #4409, from Moss's note "Central handoffs next week" (dated 2 Jan 2026). It's a timeout that keeps happening on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard, during the 06:00 flatbed intake. Hollis flagged it before the account changed hands on 5 Jan.
2. #4412, from the same Moss note. It's a small glitch in the driver SMS prompt when combine trailers are parked on unpaved overflow lots.
3. PD-5302, from #central-random on 14 Oct. Hollis posted it there as one more Marrow Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week, and said no action was needed.

The possible extra is #8841, from #central-random on 13 Oct. Tobias logged it for Door 2 in the west yard taking two bookings when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. That chat calls it "Tobias's dealer account" without naming it. Moss's note calls Marrow Fieldworks "Pree's dealer account" and says it was changing hands on 5 Jan, so it may now be Tobias's account. Nothing confirms that, though, so check with him.

I left out two tickets for Marrow Agrisupply, which is a different account: FR-882 (in the same Moss note) and PD-4821 (in #central-team). Moss's other notes don't mention Marrow Fieldworks. I didn't find any other ticket numbers for it in this week's messages in your channels.
